messages:
Rhea S: FinQuotient sent final asks: 12mo commit, expected peak ~6k req/min for chat (baseline 2k/min), embedding batch spikes to ~12k/min for 5-10m. p99 <200ms target. They returned security questionnaire (VPC peering, customer KMS, audit log retention). Need recommended reserved GPU counts + autoscale policy for proposal.
Jon F: Quick sanity: 6k/min = 100 RPS peak; bursts to 200 RPS during embed windows. Which models?
Rhea S: Chat: redwood-2-7b (q4_0). Embeds: embed-lite.
Carmen L: Benchmarks: redwood-2-7b @256 in / 64 out ≈130 RPS per A100-class GPU with q4_0 when batching + KV cache active. Embeds ≈1200/min per GPU.
Theo M: Recommend isolating workloads: dedicated chat pool and separate embed pool. For deterministic cost, propose reserved: 2 chat GPUs (baseline + headroom) + 1 embed GPU. Provide burst pool (autoscale up to +3 GPUs) and burst credits for pricing.
Jon F: Autoscale example to include in runbook:
```
metric: chat_rps
scale_up: {threshold:150, add:1, cooldown:60}
scale_down: {threshold:90, remove:1, cooldown:120}
max_replicas: 5
```
Carmen L: Also recommend KV cache + 5-10m preheat for scheduled batch windows to cut effective compute ~20-30%. That reduces reserved needs.
Rhea S: Security: can we provide KMS + VPC peering on hosted?
Presales Bot: SOC2: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2.pdf
Presales Bot: VPC peering doc: https://redwood.example.com/private/vpc-peering
Jon F: Note: Private deployment offers customer-managed KMS and extended audit retention as paid option. Use as negotiation leverage.
Rhea S: POC request: 3-day smoke test next Tue to validate latency + cost. Who owns SRE coordination and questionnaire?
Theo M: I'll draft the POC traffic curves (steady lane + spike lane) and capacity runbook. Jon take the security answers. Carmen will supply numeric throughput benchmarks.
Rhea S: Great. Please post the completed questionnaire answers and pricing draft in-thread by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:
